reason: Critical execution blockers remain: infinite recursion in counterfactual computation and a non-functional main() prevent any run from completing. Several required metrics are missing/misnamed. With one iteration left (max 21), we should prioritize fixes that unblock execution and align outputs with the spec so the simulation can be validated.

specific_areas: Remove infinite recursion in Simulation.run() by guarding counterfactual runs with a _is_counterfactual flag and compute CF only once
Restore functional main(): construct Simulation, honor CLI (output, csv-out, validate, fast-smoke-run), and produce JSON/CSV outputs
Align metrics with spec: add final_adoption_rate, adoption_inequality_index via gini(), supply_shortage_days, enforcement_actions_count; gate disease metrics when disabled
Cap enforcement by enforcement_capacity_per_day and decrement capacity as incidents are recorded
Track daily_demand and daily_sold; compute supply_shortage_days and include both series
Move daily_new_adopters calculation to end-of-day (post-enforcement) by comparing pre-/post-day states
Fix supply-demand validation to include initial stock in produced balance and ensure distributed == acquired
Remove redundant pass statements to reduce confusion and improve readability
Optional if time remains: implement rationing_policy='first_come' with unmet demand tracking

result_evaluation.adjustments: Compute and expose final_adoption_rate, adoption_inequality_index, supply_shortage_days, and enforcement_actions_count; gate disease metrics to null/omit when disabled.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide concise change logs and diffs focusing on recursion guard, main() pipeline, metric additions, and enforcement cap; note any de-scoped features due to iteration limit.
